Summary: Surrender is yielding our wills, plans, and very lives to God, trusting that his wisdom is better than our control. Mary answered the angel, Let it be to me according to your word; Jesus prayed in Gethsemane, Not my will, but yours. Surrender is not defeat but freedom: the daily laying down of our crowns before the King who gave himself for us.
